film.renderer: CadexStudio studio (engine), CPU, no browser or display
film.floor: the review viewport's dark prototype mat (ADR-444)
film.overlay: simulation seconds, bottom left of every frame

marker.what: a ring centred on the target point in force at the frame's time, drawn over the solids, in a seed whose trace carries a point goal

film.showing: tessellated solids of the accepted revision at each recorded pose, on the course each seed's trace stood on when it names one (ADR-734); collision proxies and world geometry not drawn

overview.view: hero: 35 degrees round from the front, 20 above the floor; one window on the whole path

detail.view: side-on to the direction the base travelled, 12 degrees above the floor; the window follows the base

print_bed.approximation: each printed part seated on its largest flat face (the face it can rest on with nothing below it) and turned to its smallest footprint, then packed onto as many beds as it takes by MaxRects with a fixed gap; a picture of a layout, not a slicer's plate: no supports, brim or orientation for strength are considered

shove.error: --no-video: no shove video was asked for
